name: cma-account-audit
title: CMA Account Audit
description: Project-scoped Tautulli account synchronization for Cameron-Media Account Administration.
changeNotes: Announce Access Retained only where a review genuinely existed. A ticket staged 'Active' for a previously Inactive account is a review awaiting its first notice and is unchanged; a newly onboarded member is also staged 'Active' but was never under review, so a first-ever stream no longer closes a review that never opened. Fixes the false retention notices sent to five members between 16 and 20 September 2026 (OPS-496). Supersedes 1.3.4, which over-corrected by removing the staged-review case entirely. No other tickets, sends, review stages, notification ceilings or scope boundaries change.
